agglomerated: stage 2: vv's agglomerated family, frozen and approved separately; nothing run on it before

auxiliary_tests.rule: the oracle suite on the frozen build: every node id below must pass (none skipped, deselected or missing); it holds the positive fixtures, the boundary cases, every control, the contract and frozen-code checks and the runner's own tests

controls.rule: every control demonstrated and failing as stated, with its proof at the output

library: the SHA-256 of the spike library built from this commit is in the freeze record, not here

placement.machine_independent: an instance's record does not depend on the machine: the same library bytes (one build, its SHA-256 checked by the runner on every instance), CPU kernels only, the oracle in exact rational arithmetic (Python fractions)
placement.rule: every stage 1 instance on spark-5512 (no deadline); spark-5359 is not used for the held-out

candidates.name: uniform-hex-linear-N4
candidates.why_not_certified: R > 0: a linear field carries the geometry radii (face/cell centroids, volumes, weights) into the gradient; g_hat = G exactly for LSQ and for fp32 GG, not for fp64 GG

candidates.name: uniform-hex-zero-component-N4
candidates.why_not_certified: as uniform-hex-linear-N4 (a zero component does not remove the radii of the others)

candidates.name: tet-constant-N4
candidates.why_not_certified: LSQ certifies R = 0 (zero differences); Green-Gauss has R > 0 (q times the area and moment sums, whose geometry radii are nonzero), with g_hat = G exactly

candidates.name: hex-perturbed-constant-N4
candidates.why_not_certified: LSQ certifies R = 0; Green-Gauss has R > 0 and g_hat != G exactly (perturbed geometry)

candidates.name: single-cell-hex-linear
candidates.why_not_certified: as uniform-hex-linear-N4 (boundary case: it passes checks 1-4, it does not certify R = 0)

candidates.name: hex-N3-linear
candidates.why_not_certified: as uniform-hex-linear-N4 with N = 3 (non-dyadic 1/3): neither R = 0 nor g_hat = G exactly (boundary case: it passes checks 1-4)

positive_fixtures.criterion: certified exact: R = 0 on every cell and component, g_hat = G exactly, and checks 1-4 clean, for every policy and method (ADR 0003, positive fixtures); selected on B sizes among the declared candidates

reporting.per_class_radii: a separate pass after the stage results, on the same frozen instances; reporting only, never read by the gate

verdict: fail-closed (heldout.collect): every instance's record present and passing with full coverage, and the fixtures, boundary cases and controls passing; stage 1 results are recorded, not a verdict; no PASS until stage 2; a stage 1 failure stays a failure
